purpose: Descriptive robustness diagnostics for the production v2 specification. Results are current-vintage recalculations and do not change the production score.

UST_2Y.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)

UST_10Y.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)

correlation_concentration.diagnostic: Pearson correlation of production weekly level inputs
correlation_concentration.caution: Level correlations may reflect common trends and are not return correlations.

rolling_component_correlations.diagnostic: Rolling Pearson correlation of clipped production component z-scores
rolling_component_correlations.caution: Current-vintage component correlations are descriptive and can change when the full-sample normalization history is recalculated.

contribution_concentration.diagnostic: Absolute contribution concentration adjusted by absolute component correlations
contribution_concentration.method: p_i = |weight_i * clipped_z_i| / sum_j |weight_j * clipped_z_j|; HHI = p'p; correlated concentration = p'|R|p; effective counts are reciprocals.
contribution_concentration.caution: Heuristic transparency diagnostic only. It is not a covariance risk model, portfolio diversification measure, forecast, or alternative score methodology.

limitations: The production score is descriptive, not predictive.
Current-vintage source histories can differ from historical as-published vintages.
Leave-one-out and rolling-window variants are diagnostics, not alternative production models.
Correlation diagnostics use current-vintage weekly levels or component z-scores and may reflect common trends.
The correlation-adjusted contribution concentration is a transparent heuristic, not a covariance risk model.
2008 is outside canonical v2 because the production specification begins in 2015 and includes Bitcoin.
